description: Enter your birthday for a live countdown to your next one — days, hours, minutes and seconds — plus the age you'll turn and a fun message.

faqs.a: Then the countdown shows zero and you'll get a happy birthday message along with your new age.
faqs.q: What if my birthday is today?

faqs.a: In non-leap years the countdown targets February 28, and a note explains the adjustment.
